subject: Customer incident: RapidBank throughput surge — log & custody questions
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@rapidbank.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Wu <dan.wu@rapidbank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Latency spike + errors this morning — we need logs and custody info

Aditya,

We saw a severe latency/5xx spike between 06:40-07:15 PT this morning on our integrated endpoints (orders API). Throughput dropped and retried traffic caused cascading errors on our side. Support ticket #RB-3241 opened already.

We need the following urgently for our internal execs and compliance team:
- A timestamped export of request/response latency and error rate for the tenant ID: rapidbank-prod for 06:00–08:00 PT.
- Any runtime traces or sampled request payloads (PII redacted) you can share.
- Confirmation of how long logs are retained and whether preservation for a legal hold is possible.
- Chain-of-custody / access list for the artifacts (who had access to the logs during collection).

Dan (cc) is looping in Legal. Please advise next steps and ETA; our head of infra will escalate to our CRO if we don't have evidence by EOD.

Thanks,
Priya
Ops Lead, Integrations
RapidBank

[Attachment: screenshot_errors_20261120.png (image/png) — not included]

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@rapidbank.com>
Cc: Dan Wu <dan.wu@rapidbank.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Latency spike + errors this morning — we need logs and custody info

Priya — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. We've opened an incident (INC-20261120-rapidbank) and our on-call is collecting artifacts now. Quick notes / ask:

1) I'm attaching the initial incident summary and a small sample of access logs we've pulled (access_log_sample.csv). That file is redacted for PII.
2) For the full export we'll need to confirm scope (full tenant vs. per-route). Please confirm you want: (a) entire tenant, or (b) only /v1/orders routes.
3) Legal hold / custody: we can snapshot and preserve the artifacts — we will need a written request (reply to this thread) that specifies the preservation window. We will preserve the snapshot for 90 days by default and can extend on request.

Next steps: I've looped Monica (CS lead) to help coordinate SCP (secure copy) delivery and Marcus (cc'd on the internal forward) for exec communications. If you want, we can stand up an SFTP or SharePoint secure transfer; otherwise we'll deliver via a shared signed Drive link with access logs.

ETA: short sample attached now; full exports and trace bundles expected in ~4 hours pending scope confirmation.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: redwood_incident_summary.pdf (application/pdf), access_log_sample.csv (text/csv)]

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@rapidbank.com>, Dan Wu <dan.wu@rapidbank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Latency spike + errors this morning — custody + evidence asks (for SOC/forensics)

Folks — forwarding RapidBank. They need artifact exports and chain-of-custody detail for exec/legal. Please treat this as high priority. Specific asks from the customer: full tenant export 06:00–08:00 PT (if requested), runtime traces, who accessed logs during collection, retention policy, and the ability to place a legal hold.

Action items I need:
- Monica: coordinate secure delivery mechanism and confirm customer scope (tenant vs route).
- Sean: produce a runtime/telemetry export (timestamped) and a summary of any runtime config changes or retries that could explain increased error rate. Include sampling of KV cache hits/misses if available.
- Evelyn: provide a short chain-of-custody statement template we can share externally and confirm our standard preservation periods and extension options. Also indicate whether any raw request payloads that contain PII must go through redaction or if we can provide redacted payload samples.
- Marcus: prep a one-pager for the exec briefing (2 slides) summarizing root-cause timeline and custody status.

Customer is expecting artifacts by ~13:00 PT. I'm marking this as critical — please acknowledge and confirm ETA in-thread.

Thanks,
Aditya

--- Forwarded message attached below (original customer message).

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@rapidbank.com>, Dan Wu <dan.wu@rapidbank.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Latency spike + errors this morning — custody + evidence asks (for SOC/forensics)

Acknowledged — I'm owning the custody/retention deliverables. Quick summary and what we'll provide externally:

1) Artifacts to produce (final delivery):
   - Runtime telemetry export: timestamped CSV of request_id, route, latency_ms, status_code, node_id (sampled to remove payloads) — file: runtime_export_20261120.zip
   - Access log sample (redacted): access_log_sample.csv (already attached by Aditya).
   - Incident summary: redwood_incident_summary.pdf (contains timeline, mitigations, and whether fallback to model variant occurred).

2) Redaction and PII: any raw request/response payloads with potential PII must be redacted before external delivery. We will provide redacted samples and the redaction script hash for audit.

3) Chain-of-custody statement (external):
   - We will provide a signed custody statement listing: who exported artifacts (ops), who stored them (secure S3 bucket + key prefix), who accessed the artifacts (IAM roles + time window), and the checksums of delivered files.
   - Internal access during collection: ops_oncall@redwood.ai and seanc@redwood.ai performed the collection. (If customer requests different granularity we can expand.)

4) Retention and legal hold:
   - Default log retention for tenant artifacts is 30 days.
   - We can create a preservation snapshot on request; standard preservation period is 90 days (extendable with written justification).

5) Delivery method: we'll generate a Drive link with restricted viewers + time-limited access and an access log that shows download timestamps and identities. If the customer requires, we can also deliver via an SFTP endpoint with one-time credentials.

6) ETA: We'll deliver the initial artifact package (runtime_export_20261120.zip with the telemetry CSV and the incident summary) by 13:00 PT today. I'll attach the custody statement and checksums in that package.

I'll upload the package to the secured drive folder and paste the link once ready. Marcus, please advise if you want edits to the exec one-pager before we send externally. Monica/Sean — please confirm when the export is uploaded.

Evelyn Hart
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: custody_statement_template.txt (text/plain) — internal copy; final signed PDF will be included in delivery]
